operation.description: The operation to perform: 'encode' for Quoted-Printable encoding, 'decode' for decoding.

input_file.description: The input file path. Use '-' for standard input.

output_file.description: The output file path. Use '-' for standard output.

binary_mode.description: If true, treats input/output as pure binary (-b/--binary).

ebcdc_mode.description: If true, encodes ASCII characters for EBCDIC compatibility (-i/--ebdic).

no_error_check.description: If true, suppresses error checking on decode (-n/--noerrcheck).

paranoid_mode.description: If true, encodes every character as an escape sequence (-p/--paranoid).
